description.en: Minimalist and experimental UI components exploring frontier web aesthetics.
description.zh: 探索前沿 Web 交互美学与极简概念边界的实验性 React UI 组件库。

content.en: devl is an experimental sandbox and component gallery exploring minimalist typography, stark monochromatic contrasts, and avant-garde interactive physics on the web. It serves as a creative playground for design engineers pushing modern digital aesthetics.
content.zh: devl 是一座探索极简黑白排版美学与先锋交互概念的实验性组件艺廊。它运用极致克制的线条构图、冷峻的单色对比与前卫的物理力学反馈，挑战千篇一律的商业 UI 范式，为设计工程师提供突破常规的先锋交互灵感。
